idea: Build CrownCut, a luxury barber salon booking app with haircut & beard service menu, master stylist selection, appointment time slot picker, and booking receipt confirmation
tagline: Exquisite Grooming & Concierge Reservation Platform for Premier Salons
targetAudience: Discerning high-end clients seeking premium grooming experiences alongside boutique salon owners and master stylists demanding a white-glove, unbranded digital reservation tool.

mvpFeatures.name: Master Stylist Craftsmanship Showcase
mvpFeatures.description: High-resolution media galleries displaying master barber portfolios, client transformations, signature techniques, and curated service badges.

mvpFeatures.name: Bespoke Service Menu & Packages
mvpFeatures.description: Interactive service menu offering precision haircuts, bespoke beard treatments, executive spa packages, and transparent premium pricing with custom service durations.

mvpFeatures.name: VIP Concierge Preference Selector
mvpFeatures.description: Pre-appointment preference module allowing clients to select complimentary beverages (e.g., single malt scotch, espresso), conversation tone (Silent Service vs. Engaging), and hot towel essential oil scents.

mvpFeatures.name: Real-Time Slot & Suite Picker
mvpFeatures.description: Dynamic time slot picker synced with stylist calendars and private suite availability to prevent overbooking and guarantee punctuality.

mvpFeatures.name: VIP Digital Receipt & Pass Confirmation
mvpFeatures.description: A luxury gold-accented digital pass generated post-booking, featuring calendar auto-sync, client preference summary, directions, and Apple/Google Wallet integration.

mvpFeatures.name: Barber Schedule & Client Intel Hub
mvpFeatures.description: Dedicated tablet/mobile portal for stylists to view incoming client preferences, appointment timelines, and historical styling notes with zero per-appointment commission deductions.

futureFeatures.name: White-Label Brand Customization Engine
futureFeatures.description: Allows individual elite lounges to apply custom visual identity, bespoke color palettes, and custom domain names for total brand independence.

futureFeatures.name: Tiered VIP Membership & Grooming Subscriptions
futureFeatures.description: Automated monthly recurring retainer packages offering priority reservation windows, complimentary upgrades, and private lounge access.

futureFeatures.name: Stylist Direct Earnings & Instant Payouts
futureFeatures.description: Integrated payout system enabling master stylists to receive tips and service earnings immediately post-appointment.

userPersonas.name: Harrison Vance - Managing Director
painPoints: Frustrated by noisy, generic booking apps with mass-market branding
Dislikes repeating refreshment and quiet service preferences at every appointment
Demands exact punctuality and elite craftsmanship without salon booking friction
goals: Seamlessly reserve preferred master barber in a private suite
Customize pre-service environment (espresso ready, minimal talk)
Receive a sleek digital calendar pass for easy scheduling

userPersonas.name: Dante Rossi - Master Barber & Shop Founder
painPoints: Losing up to 20% margin to third-party commission-based marketplace apps
Generic marketplace UI diluting the salon's high-end, exclusive brand equity
Inability to record fine-grained client preferences and past formula notes
goals: Maintain a white-glove direct booking experience for high-value clientele
Eliminate booking commissions while retaining 100% client relationship data
Review VIP client preferences prior to arrival for flawless service execution

userJourneys.flowName: Booking an Executive Grooming Service with Concierge Preferences
userJourneys.description: The client browses master stylists, customizes their service and luxury preferences, picks a slot, and receives a VIP pass.
steps: Launch CrownCut app and select the local luxury lounge profile.
Browse Master Stylist portfolios and select preferred barber based on specialized service tags.
Choose services: 'Executive Precision Cut' and 'Hot Towel Beard Sculpt'.
Open Concierge Preferences screen to select 'Quiet Service Mode', 'Sparkling Water', and 'Eucalyptus Oil Towel'.
Select an available appointment time slot on the interactive luxury calendar UI.
Review booking summary, enter payment authorization, and generate the CrownCut Gold VIP Receipt.
Save pass to Apple Wallet and automatically sync reservation to personal calendar.

screens.purpose: Allows clients to pick grooming services and customize their pre-appointment environment.

screens.name: Schedule & Time Slot Selector Screen
screens.purpose: Enables seamless date and time slot selection synchronized with real-time room and barber availability.

screens.name: VIP Digital Receipt & Pass Screen
screens.purpose: Presents a premium pass detailing booking information, concierge choices, and access QR code.

screens.name: Stylist Schedule & Client Intel Screen

keyComponents: Status Update Toggle (Ready / In Progress / Completed)

monetizationModel: B2B SaaS subscription model charged to luxury salons ($149–$299/month per lounge depending on stylist count) with zero commission fees on appointments, keeping client relationships directly with the salon.
